title: Brandon Peterson
description: THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK's dramatic revelation; Luke vs. Vader in the Cloud City of Bespin. "My inspiration for this card was the scene in EMPIRE when Vader offers his hand towards Luke as Luke dangles," explains Brandon Peterson. "It is the moment that Luke turns completely from the dark side. It is the ultimate moment in the series, as far as I'm concerned." Illustrator Peterson has worked on Marvel's X-MEN titles and is currently drawing CODENAME: STRYKEFORCE for Image.
